MANDAR VISPUTE 
B.TECH. ELECTRICAL 
ENGINEERING     
2021-2025

1 
 
 
Internship Details 
 
Eligibility Criteria: 
CPI: 6.00+ 
Branches: EXTC, Electronics, Electrical 
 
Roles: 
 Field Application Engineer (FAE)  
 Technical Sales Associate (TSA) 
 
Stipend: INR 50,000 /- per month plus a one-time 
relocation benefit of INR 25,000/- 
 
Location: Bangalore/Pune/Delhi.

2 
 
 
Pre-Placement Talk (PPT) - 27th July, 2023 
 
The Pre-Placement Talk of TI was conducted in Online Mode on 27th July, 2023 
around 5:00pm. The Talk included the HR Team as well as a few senior 
representatives from TI. 
It began with TI’s vision and passion which is “ At our core, we have a passion to 
create a better world by making electronics more affordable through 
semiconductors. This passion is alive today as we continue to pioneer advances 
in integrated circuits. Each generation of innovation builds upon the last to make 
technology smaller, more efficient, more reliable and more affordable – opening 
new markets and making it possible for semiconductors to go into electronics 
everywhere. We think of this as an Engineering process. They also discuss with 
us about their variety of products, working domains , their  its businesses, 
impact, global presence, local presence in India, revenue and other details about 
the company .They also talk about important topics regarding assessment 
(MCQ)test and give some tips about how to crack it . So yes it is important to 
attend ppt for one who really wish to crack the exam and work with TI.E

3 
 
Online test Assesment : 
 
We were sent a registration link few days before the test where we had to fill 
out basic personal details and select the preference for role (TSA/FAE/Both). I 
selected FAE . As my interest is more towards technical things. They also sent 
us  documents containing job description of the roles and a prep guide for the 
interview. This guid contained all the information about the scope of the 
interview, their expectations from candidates, how to answer questions and 
even YouTube playlists and textbooks that the candidates should cover. This 
was the key to cracking this interview as the interview process very closely 
followed the prep guide. Some key expectations are : 
Strong basics of Analog electronics: BJT/MOSFET/Op-amps/Data 
converters/Power converters etc . 
Able to understand/visualize end applications/systems .  
Able to quickly analyze/debug electronic systems/PCBs . 
The online assessment had two sections: 
a. Technical (20 questions): This section had questions on all topics 
encompassing electrical syllabus including and not limited to 
Electrical Networks, Electrical Devices, Analog Devices, Amplifiers, 
Filters, Microprocessors, Control Systems, etc. The questions were of 
varying difficulty and types. One important thing to note is that there 
was a negative marking scheme of +1/-0.25. 
b. Aptitude (20 questions): This section had common aptitude style 
questions on comprehension, statistics, logical reasoning, etc.

4 
 
Interview Round 1 - 5th September, 2023 
 
For interview keep dressing normal formal one. Total 22 Students were 
shortlisted for the interviews, 11 each in TSA and FAE. Interviews were 
conducted offline in-person in TPO, 9am onwards. Panelists for both roles were 
different. 
My interview started around 10 am. I was asked to submit the resume and give 
introduction about myself . Keep the introduction short and sweet and also 
your resume should reflect your best in short way . In this round interviewer 
give me two questions to solve one is to draw mobile charger circuit and 
another is about Bjt and Zener diode combinational circuit output . Interviewer 
is very friendly to us they do not pressurized us and give some hints also. 
Another question he asked is to draw diagram of astable multivibrator and it’s 
waveform. Then he send me for my 2nd interview to another interviewer.

5 
 
Interview Round 2 - 
 
My second interview starts immediately after first one . In this interview only 
one person is their and he ask me to introduce myself . This interview is mostly 
focused on my resume . In my resume I wrote about projects that I did in past. 
In which I used various components as 555ic , Lm293d motor driver , aurduino 
uno , BO motors and another sensors. He asked me about this components only 
, like how much current is consumed by motor and at voltage is it working , block 
diagram of 555 ic and its working etc . Then he started to ask questions about 
syllabus of previous sems , filters and their outputs . So this second interview is 
mainly about previous projects . After this one HR round is their in it interviewer 
ask about myself and she gives more  information about role and asked my 
compatibility with locations.

6 
 
General Interview Tips & Guidelines 
CV: 
1. Clearly mention key achievements, projects, papers / publications, interest 
areas and grades in relevant courses 
Personal Interview: 
2. Think out loud while solving any question. The Interviewer judges you on the 
approach and not the answer. 
3. Pay attention to the question and think before proceeding, it is okay to take 
few seconds before answering if you are not sure. 
4. If you don’t know the answer or are not sure about the answer, then 
mention the same before answering. 
5. There might be questions on areas that you have not worked on. That does 
not mean you completely give up and not answer. Try answering the questions 
based on the hints provided by the   interviewer. The interviewer is trying to 
see if you would be able to solve a question logically even though you do not 
have a background on the topic. 
6. Show curiosity and your drive to solve problems. Ask questions, seek help 
and think aloud. 
7. If you have hit a roadblock, don’t be afraid to go back to square one and start 
afresh on a new path.
